entities.summary: Cedric Glenn Ball is an American former professional basketball player born in Worcester, Massachusetts. He had a brief stint with the Los Angeles Clippers during the 1990–91 NBA season. Ball, a 6-foot-8-inch (2.03 m) and 210-pound (95 kg) small forward, attended South High Community School in Worcester and the University of North Carolina at Charlotte.
